ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time (price list). The hall has 8-hour, 12-hour and 24-hour rates; night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Advance receipt of packages is in principle for arrival on the day before the event, and an advance load-in notice is required. (Source: Hall price list, updated July 3, 2026; FAQ)
ops.loadingHours: When there is load-in or load-out, an advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave within the usage time. The permitted dimensions of the loading area are 3,000 mm total height x 6,200 mm total length (up to 2-ton trucks), and loading and unloading work is in principle limited to 20 minutes. The 1F Event Hall can be loaded in by 4-ton truck. The halls on B1F and 2F have an underfloor pit structure. Packages received in advance are in principle limited to 5 boxes per hall. The on-site manager completes entry procedures at the Service Center on the 1F of Sumitomo Fudosan Shiodome Hamarikyu Building. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 16, official facility page)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking and roadside parking around the building outside the designated parking lot are strictly prohibited. Products, packing materials, decoration materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. If delivery vehicle traffic is expected to be congested, traffic staff are placed at the entrance. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Articles 15 and 16)
ops.parking: To find nearby hourly parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Shiodome" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page.
ops.waitingRooms: The 2F Event Hall has 2 waiting rooms (13㎡, 7㎡), and the B1F Event Hall has 5 waiting rooms (13㎡, 8㎡, 12㎡, 10㎡, 10㎡). All are free of charge (usage fee 0 yen) and cannot be used on their own. (Source: Official facility page)
ops.catering: Outside food/drink brought in is allowed. However, if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used, an "outside food/drink fee" applies (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide PDF, FAQ)
